schemas.description: Generate seamlessly tiling photorealistic images from text using Z-Image Turbo

input_params.name: acceleration
input_params.description: The acceleration level to use.

input_params.name: prompt
input_params.description: The prompt to generate an image from.

input_params.name: enable_prompt_expansion
input_params.description: Whether to enable prompt expansion. Note: this will increase the price by 0.0025 credits per request.

input_params.name: tile_size
input_params.description: Tile size in latent space. Must be even (divisible by 2) for patchification. Automatically capped to the generated image dimensions on tiled axes. (64 = 512px, 128 = 1024px, 256 = 2048px).

input_params.name: image_size
input_params.description: The size of the generated image. Use 'auto' to match the input image size (or 1024x1024 if no image).

input_params.name: output_format
input_params.description: The format of the generated image.

input_params.name: tiling_mode
input_params.description: Tiling direction: 'both' (omnidirectional), 'horizontal' (left-right only), 'vertical' (top-bottom only).

input_params.name: num_images
input_params.description: The number of images to generate.

input_params.name: num_inference_steps
input_params.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

input_params.name: mask_image_url
input_params.description: URL of a mask image for inpainting. White regions are regenerated, black regions are preserved. Requires image_url.

input_params.name: seed
input_params.description:
The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model
            will output the same image every time.

input_params.name: image_url
input_params.description: URL of an image for image-to-image or inpainting. When provided without mask_image_url, performs image-to-image; with mask_image_url, performs inpainting.

input_params.name: tile_stride
input_params.description: Tile stride in latent space. Must be even (divisible by 2). Automatically capped to half the effective tile size. (32 = 256px, 64 = 512px, 128 = 1024px).

input_params.name: enable_safety_checker

schemas.selection_guidance:
Before choosing a model for a new operation, call recommend_model with the user's task and constraints unless the user named a model or explicitly requested a model set/comparison. Reuse that recommendation for the operation; do not repeatedly request the same recommendation.
For an explicit set/comparison, use list_model_sets to resolve the requested operation and sets, then use its exact returned endpoint IDs within the user's requested scope. Read each selected model's live schema and applicable published guidance, build its input from the user's brief and references, and preserve required settings. Explain incompatible or unavailable members instead of silently replacing them, approximating settings, or running the rest of a large set. Set membership is discovery, never authorization or proof of task fit.
Honor an explicitly requested model; verify its exact endpoint and do not silently substitute it.
Copy endpoint_id exactly from the live catalog. Namespaces and versions vary by provider: never add or change a provider prefix, invent an endpoint from a model name, or reuse a guessed alias. When a named model is missing or unavailable, search_models can resolve current catalog matches; explain any mismatch with the requested endpoint before choosing a replacement. An unavailable endpoint alone does not establish that the user connected the wrong account.
Otherwise use current applicable published guidance in recommended_model and model_knowledge after checking the user's real sources, required capabilities and scoped budget. Follow the next compatible published fallback and explain why. If published guidance is missing or outdated, use search_models and search_docs to evaluate current candidates. A new endpoint can qualify without adoption statistics, but recency alone does not establish quality. Do not submit a choice with decision_status needs_input, no_compatible_candidate or evidence_unavailable. A workflow_needed result needs a verified dependent plan before spend.
With draft_inspection_required, draft_candidate establishes technical/reference fit only. Generate a draft only within existing user authorization and the checked budget, then inspect it against original conditioning sources before dependent generation or approval. Preservation stays unverified; a draft candidate is not a final recommended_model or permission to spend.
Catalog order, popularity and release recency are discovery signals, not quality or latency rankings. Fast subject motion describes movement in the scene, not generation latency. Only treat user-requested settings as hard constraints; do not invent an exact resolution or audio requirement to justify switching models.
Live retrieval does not establish when guidance was authored. Without an update date, freshness is unknown; verify capabilities in current schemas/docs and do not claim the pick is the newest or fastest without evidence. Skills and workflow examples supply production advice, not competing model defaults. Prefer current published task/domain guidance over bundled family rankings. Use get_pricing for the actual settings before material spending. Cost estimates preserve units and cover only known quantities, not final billing guarantees. Pass the optional decision_id to run_model, submit_job or each applicable batch item; it links observations and is never authorization.

evidence.latency_definition: Successful execution observations in milliseconds; mixed workloads; excludes queue/startup; not runtime guarantees.
evidence.instructions: Successful execution observations in milliseconds; mixed workloads; excludes queue/startup; not runtime guarantees. Report p50/p90 with their measurement window. Null means unknown, never zero. Trending is the analytics category rank at its source timestamp, not adoption or quality. New means registry publication within 30 days of the response evaluation time, not first usage. Lab recommendations are authored guidance, not measured latency, trending or newness. Use the existing pricing tool for current prices, preserving billing units and required configuration; these observations contain no prices.

selection_resolution: General recommender did not resolve specialized capabilities and treated literal 1024x1024 as an unmatched resolution enum. Targeted catalog discovery plus exact schemas establish both-axis latent tiling at custom 1024 or 512 for Z-Image, and native transparency with 1:1 ratio for Ideogram. Ideogram exposes no exact pixel-size control: actual dimensions and layout would require verification after output. Commercial-use labels and configuration-specific prices were verified on model pages. Safety checker remains enabled; no prompt expansion. Optional decal was deferred; Ideogram does not expose a 4:1 aspect ratio.
